notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin and Nurturing Presence attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Cinderhaze Wretch token enters the battlefield, the nontoken Cinderhaze Wretch triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
